claims.call: The Devils’ power play creates at least their usual 8.6 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Devils’ power play is one of the league’s best, and the Islanders’ kill is one of the worst. Every trip to the box hurts the Islanders more than most.

NYI.head: The Islanders face a real test
NYI.body: New Jersey has been out-chancing opponents lately, but the Islanders have home-ice advantage. The Islanders can pull it off if they keep the shots coming.

NJD.head: The Devils should have the upper hand
NJD.body: New Jersey has been out-chancing opponents lately, but the Islanders have home-ice advantage. The Islanders’ way back in is piling up shots.

paras: The Devils come in at 1-0-0, the Islanders at 0-1-0.

items.text: The Devils have been without Connor Brown all season.
The Islanders have been without Mathew Barzal all season. Counting how much each missing player usually brings, only the Blue Jackets and the Ducks are missing more right now.
Jack Hughes has six goals in eight games against the Islanders since 2023-24.
Timo Meier is set to play his 700th NHL game.
